facts.material: knit fabric of hemp and cotton (proportions not stated)

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 6110 covers sweaters, pullovers and similar articles, knitted; chapter 61 note 1 (made up knitted articles) does not exclude it
GRI 6: 6110.20 (cotton) vs 6110.90 (other textile materials); hemp is not cotton, and section XI note 2 classifies by the predominant fiber by weight, assumed here to be hemp
GRI 6: 6110.90.90 Other; men's pullover in the 'Other (338)' statistical line

rejected_alternatives.reason: applies only if cotton is the predominant fiber by weight; the order 'hemp and cotton' suggests hemp predominates
requires 36 percent or more flax fibers; hemp is not flax
sweater line; the goods are described as pullover, not specified as sweaters by gauge

missing_facts: percent by weight of hemp vs cotton
whether the garment is a sweater (heavier knit) or a lighter pullover
classification.rationale: Heading 6110 covers knitted pullovers. G81233 (in force) classifies a men's cotton knit pullover under the old 6110.20.2065 line, i.e. a different fiber; it shows only the men's pullover structure, not the hemp/cotton case. Hemp-predominant pullovers fall in 6110.90 Other; fiber proportions are assumed, so the suffix is uncertain.
